verses.text: Ha Jehová tz'alan icha tik: Ha ex tze nib'ej he b'eyb'alej tojolal, tze nib'ej tzex jawi t'ayin, ab'ek wal tas ol wala': Ileknab' b'aj kotnak eyinhtilal, b'aj pax kotnak yinhtilal heb' he mam eyicham.
Ina winh he mam eyicham aj Abraham yet' ix he nun chichim ix Sara, malaj yuninal heb' ayik wawtannak heb', palta wak'nak in wach'k'olal t'a heb', tzijtum ix aj yinhtilal heb'.

Ol wak' in wach'k'olal t'a Sion, haton jun chonhab' mak'b'ilem lanhnajok. Ha lum takinh lu'um, ol yaxb'okkan sat lu'um, icha lum Edén ol aj lu'um. Yuj chi' ol tzalaj heb' kajan ta', ol b'itan heb', ol yak'an yuj diosal heb' t'ayin.
Ex in chonhab', maklejek eyab' tas ol wala', ab'ek ex junjun chonhab': Ol walel in k'ayb'ub'al yet' in cheknab'il. Icha sakil k'inal ol aj t'ayex.

Lak'anxo sja sk'ual in ch'olb'itani, wan sjapax sk'ual yik tzin kolwaji. Ha yet' in poder ol wak'an yajalil t'a yib'anh juntzanh chonhab'. Ha juntzanh chonhab' ay t'a stitak ha' mar, ol yak'och in poder heb' yipok sk'ool.

K'eanhek k'elan t'a satcha'anh, tzex empax k'elan t'a sat lu'um tik. Ha satcha'anh chi', ol satem icha satem te' tab', haxo sat lum tik, ol k'ab'ok icha sk'ab'i junok pichul. Ha heb' anima kajan t'a sat lum tik, ol satel heb' icha satel nok' us. Palta a kolnab'il swak'a' ay t'a junelnhej. Ha in tojolal malaj slajwub'.
Ha ex eyojtak tojolal, ex tzeyak'och in cheknab'il t'a he k'ool, ab'ek: Manh ex xiw yuj sb'uchwal lolonel heb' anima t'ayex. Mokab' chab'ax he k'ool yuj tas syal heb' chi',
yujto ol satel heb' icha junok pichul ijtakxo, ma icha tz'aj junok lana pichul sk'uxjib'at yuj nok' ij. Palta a in tojolal yet' in kolwal aynhejek' t'a junelnhej, xchi Jehová.
Mamin Jehová, kolwajanh, kotanh yet' a poder, icha a k'ulejnak t'a peka'. Ha ach chok' utejnak nok' niwan nok' t'a yol ha' mar, haton nok' Rahab.
Ha ach a jaknak ha' mar, haton ha' te jul yich, ha t'a sjulal yich ha' mar chi', icha b'e utejnak yik tzek' heb' kolb'il uuj.
Ichaton chi' ol aj smeltzaj heb' kolb'ilxo el uj Mamin Jehová. Ol jawok heb' t'a Sion tik yet' b'it yik tzalajk'olal. Ol tzetzon sat heb' stzalaji, ol satel ok'el yet' kusk'olal.
Ha Jehová tz'alan icha tik: Ha in Jehová in swak' eyip, ¿tas yuj tzex xiw t'a heb' anima chamelb'a yaji, to lajan heb' icha anh ank'ultak k'un stakjieli?

Ha in Jehová in, a in in b'onak ex. Ha in in jenhb'ejnakb'at satcha'anh, in b'oannakem lum lum tik t'a yet'tal. ¿Tom ix in b'atkan satk'olal eyuuj, yuj chi' tzex xiw t'a jun tzex ixtani, jun snaan ex sataneli? Palta manh ex xiwok, a in ol in satel yowal sk'ol jun tzex ixtan chi'.
Ha heb' syab' syail b'aj tz'ixtaj chi', elanhchamel ol koljok heb'. Manh ol cham heb' t'a yol preso, manh ol yak' wejel heb'.
Ha in Jehová he Diosal in, a in b'i, Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil. Ha in swak'k'e ponholjok sat ha' mar.

Ha in in jenhb'ejnakb'at satcha'anh, in b'oannakpaxem lum lum tik t'a yet'tal. Ha in swak' eyalel in lolonel, tzex in kolanel yet' in poder. Ha in swal t'a Sion: Ha ex tik in chonhab' ex, xin chi, xchi Jehová.

Hak'ekel he wayanh ex aj Jerusalén, k'eanhek waan. Ix eyab' wal syail yuj yowal sk'ol Jehová ix yak'kot t'a eyib'anh, palta toxo ix ek'b'ati. Lajan ex aj icha junok mach satel sk'ol yuk'an anh anh, manhxalaj jab'ok anh chi' syaktejkan t'a yol yet'tal.
Ha t'a skal heb' eyuninal ix eyil k'ib'ok, malaj junok heb' ix ch'oxan b'e t'ayex, malaj junok heb' ix ex ketzanb'ati.

Haton cha makan tas ix jawi t'a eyib'anh tik: Ix mak'chajem lanhnaj he chonhab', ix champax heb' kajan t'ay yuj wejel yuj owal. ¿Machto wal ol ok' sk'ol t'ayex? ¿Machto wal ol ak'an sniwanil he k'ool?

Toxo ix el yip heb' eyuninal, toxo ix telwi heb' icha nok' k'ultakil chej skan t'a ch'anh yaal. Toxonhej ix kan teljab' heb' t'a schikintak calle, yujto ix yab' wal syail yowal sk'ol Jehová he Diosal heb', yuj skachji heb' yuj.
Ex aj Jerusalén, wan eyab'an wal syail, icha uk'um anh eyek'i, palta manh ex uk'umok pax anh.

Ha Jehová Kajal ko Diosal paxi, ha' tz'alan icha tik: Ha in Jehová he Diosal in tzex in kolo', a in ton swal icha tik: Ol wik'ek' skopail yowal in k'ol chi' t'ayex, manhxa b'ak'inh ol eyab'xi syail yuj.

Ha t'a heb' ixtannak ex, hata' ol wak' jun skopail yowal in k'ol chi', haton t'a heb' aljinak t'ayex icha tik: Emanhek lachan t'a sat lu'um to ol onh b'eyek' t'a eyib'anh, xchi heb'. Emnak ex lachan t'a sat lum chi', ek'nak tek'ton heb' t'a eyib'anh icha lum pokok, xchi Jehová.
